# matter.js tests: the porting register

matter.js pin `862ad75f4d3c7ab528b8a3954168146082cad8a6` (`parity/schema.json` → `matter.sourceCommit`): 588 test files under `packages/general/test` and `packages/model/test` and `packages/node/test` and `packages/nodejs/test` and `packages/protocol/test` and `packages/thread-br-client/test` and `packages/types/test`.
Out of the roots, each for its reason: `packages/matter.js` (the umbrella package and its legacy controller API,
MatterController and PairedNode, whose behaviour the protocol and node roots hold), `packages/nodejs-ble` (Node.js BLE
bindings over noble; the module's BLE is its own Go transport), `packages/nodejs-ws` (a WebSocket transport the module
does not have), `packages/testing` (matter.js's test harness) and `support/codegen` (its TypeScript tooling).
`ported`: the Go tests cover the file's `it` cases; `partial`: they cover some, the note names the rest;
`planned`: not ported yet; `excluded`: left out, with its class. A `ported` or `partial` note's "Left"
names the `it` cases that will not be ported, each with its class and reason. The guard is `make testparity-check`.

| status | files |
| --- | ---: |
| ported | 125 |
| partial | 128 |
| planned | 63 |
| excluded | 272 |
| total | 588 |

## FixMe skips

Go tests whose body is an unconditional `t.Skip("FixMe: …")`: each names a case it would mirror and
does not test. They count as passes in `go test`; this list is where they are recorded.

| Go test | mirrors | why it skips |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cluster/core:TestParityMatterJS_BasicInfoServer_AsyncObserverMechanism_Unsupported` | matter.js packages/node/src/behaviors/basic-information/ | The `$Changed` observer API has no cluster-layer counterpart; change notification is the node's (contract.Change, OnChanged). |
| `cluster/core:TestParityMatterJS_DescriptorServer_AsyncPartsListUnsupported` | matter.js packages/node/test/behaviors/descriptor/ | The asynchronous MockServerNode lifecycle has no unit-level counterpart; the PartsList lifecycle is ported in the DescriptorServer tests the register names. |
| `cluster/core:TestParityOpcreds_PendingRootAppearsInTrustedRoots` | chip operational-credentials-server.cpp | Needs a valid RCAC TLV fixture from a test-key generator to drive AddTrustedRootCertificate. |
| `im/subscription:TestHandlerParity_SKIP_SendAlreadyInProgress_Deferred` | matter.js packages/node/src/node/server/ServerSubscription.ts:429-437 | The engine's Tick is synchronous and holds no in-flight send state; concurrent sends are exercised by the engine's race test. |
| `im/subscription:TestHandlerParity_SKIP_SendUpdateRetryCount` | matter.js packages/node/src/node/server/ServerSubscription.ts:460-521 | The send-error retry count lives in the layer that sends the report, above the engine's Reporter callback. |
| `im:TestMessengerParity_ReportDataSuppressResponseFlag` | matter.js InteractionClientMessengerTest.ts:230 | The close/status-ack ordering is Promise sequencing; the flag encoding is covered by TestReadRequestRoundTrip. |
| `im:TestPathParity_InvalidAttributePathMissingBothClusterAndAttribute` | matter.js AttributePathValidator | The path validation is the request handler's, not the TLV decoder's, which accepts the path. |
| `im:TestReadParity_ChunkingSessionNotRequired` | chip src/app/tests/TestReadInteraction.cpp:1536 (TestReadChunking) | End-to-end chunking needs the secure-session send layer; the MoreChunkedMessages encoding is covered by TestReadRequestRoundTrip. |
| `im:TestReadParity_PerChunkStatusResponseWait` | chip src/app/tests/TestReadInteraction.cpp (derived invariant) | The per-chunk StatusResponse wait lives in the session layer, not in the im package's encoders. |
| `store:TestParityChip_AddFabric_ChipStagedCommit_NotApplicable` | chip src/credentials/tests/TestFabricTable.cpp:1800 | chip's pending/commit/rollback fabric table has no store counterpart: a store write is durable per transaction. |
| `store:TestParityChip_FabricLabel_TooLongFails` | chip src/credentials/tests/TestFabricTable.cpp:2470 | The label-length limit is enforced by the OperationalCredentials server (UpdateFabricLabel), not by the store. |
| `tlv:TestObjectParity_ChunkedArray_NotImplemented` | matter.js packages/types/test/tlv/TlvArrayTest.ts:39-54 | Chunked arrays are encoded and decoded in im, not in tlv. |
| `tlv:TestObjectParity_InjectField_NotImplemented` | matter.js packages/types/test/tlv/TlvObjectTest.ts:203-264 | No TlvObject.injectField counterpart: the caller builds the struct. |
| `tlv:TestObjectParity_RemoveField_NotImplemented` | matter.js packages/types/test/tlv/TlvObjectTest.ts:286-325 | No TlvObject.removeField counterpart. |
| `tlv:TestObjectParity_TaggedList_ProtocolSpecificTags_NotImplemented` | matter.js packages/types/test/tlv/TlvObjectTest.ts:478-495 | No allowProtocolSpecificTags check: the decoder passes non-context tags through. |
| `tlv:TestObjectParity_ValidationError_NotImplemented` | matter.js packages/types/test/tlv/TlvObjectTest.ts:266-284 | No schema validation layer in tlv: validation is the cluster definitions' (cluster/spec). |
